tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS certificate verification

TLS certificate verification is required on all builds, development builds included; the project has no exception or workaround for it. This is consistent with the project's separate policy of https everywhere, with no plaintext exception.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-verification.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/tls-verification.md`. It says certificate verification is required on all builds, development builds included, with no exception or workaround. It also notes this fits the separate "https everywhere, no plaintext exception" policy.

The dev-build record is weaker than a formal decision. The earlier statement that verification was disabled in dev builds as a workaround was revoked by the later "need verification on all builds". That revocation is only an unverified session excerpt (trust 1), not a logged decision. The "https everywhere" policy is a user-stated decision (trust 3, #32).

I left out the retired workaround and the earlier plain-http-for-internal-hosts note, which the https-everywhere policy replaced.
